params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: displayFormat
params.description: New display format for the object

overloads.semanticRole: Sets, for the current display only (not stored with the form), the display format applied to the object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: The new format is used only for the current display; it is not stored with the form.
displayFormat must be compatible with the data type of the object/field it is applied to.
For Boolean fields: a single value in displayFormat renders the field as a checkbox labeled with that value; in binary databases only, two semicolon-separated values render it as two radio buttons.
For Date/Time fields or variables, a predefined format constant (from Date Display Formats / Time Display Formats) is passed as Char(n), where n is the constant's value.
